row.notes: In Game_SaveData_DeserialiseContainer, the join of the three exits of the registered-child match loop that found no child for the current child bag (empty child set 0x14364fd58, end of the set 0x14364fda1/0x14364fdc9; a match jumps to 0x143650032). Here rdi = the container, [rsp+0x88] = pointer to the current slot of the bag's 'containers' entry array (the property is *[rsp+0x88]), and the instruction reads retain_unknown (+0x100). The retain path that follows (0x14364ff0c) takes the value bag via property vt+0x38 and the name from Ne_StringTable_Lookup of the key hash.

verify.notes: V1112 Re-derived from disassembly of 0x14364f3a0. sigcheck game.save_data_unclaimed_child OK (1 hit, target 0x14364fef0). Instruction boundary; the only branches to it are 0x14364fd58 (child set count [rdi+0x170]==0), 0x14364fda1 (first slot scan reaches end [rdi+0x168]) and 0x14364fdc9 (iteration reaches end); preceding instruction 0x14364feeb is an unconditional jmp, so no fall-through; no branch anywhere (.xtls rel32/rel8 scan, .data1 rel32 scan) lands in 0x14364fef1..0x14364fef4. A match (cmp r14=FNV-1a64(node+0x10 name), [prop+type.vt20()]) leaves at 0x14364fe84 -> 0x143650032. rdi: written only from rcx at entry or reloaded from [rsp+0x38] (stored once at 0x14364f490); forward dataflow over the CFG gives rdi==container on every path into the site. [rsp+0x88] is written only at 0x14364fd09 (=containers bag+8, the entries array) and 0x1436508e7 (+=8 per child), so [[rsp+0x88]] is the current entry property of the 'containers' value (the 'containers' property is type-checked against k_Ne_PropertyType_Bag 0x146129de0 at 0x14364f9a3 and its value taken via vt+0x30 at 0x14364f9ba -> [rsp+0xc8]); the site itself does mov rsi,[rsp+0x88]; [rsi]->vt+0x38. No push/pop/rsp change between the prologue (sub rsp,0xf8) and the epilogue, so rsp at the site is the body rsp. Wording note: 'containers' is a bag-typed property whose entries are the child bags, not a list-typed (proplist) value.
